steps.title: Mars Petcare Global Architecture
steps.text: Welcome. This is the end-to-end view of our 100% Azure-centric architecture, designed for global scalability and data integrity.

steps.title: Flow Types (Sync / Async)
steps.text: We classify interactions into synchronous (for immediate web user experience) and asynchronous (for heavy lifting and B2B integration).

steps.title: Web Application (Frontend Layer)
steps.text: Built in Node.js and hosted on Azure Static Web Apps. It serves as the global multi-brand entry point.

steps.title: Dynamic Forms
steps.text: Forms and styles change dynamically based on the URL and language, driven by a master JSON to easily onboard new brands.

steps.title: Performance and Security
steps.text: We secure data entry with Azure CDN, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and API Gateway, ensuring low latency and attack mitigation.

steps.title: Identity Validation
steps.text: We implement reCAPTCHA and IP Rate Limiting to ensure only legitimate records enter our data ecosystem.

steps.title: Data Management (MDM Engine)
steps.text: Azure Functions query Cosmos DB to check if the user already exists, determining if it's a new creation or a pet portfolio update.

steps.title: Azure Service Bus (Ingestion)
steps.text: The first decoupling point. We queue the validated record here to guarantee zero data loss if downstream systems fail.

steps.title: Worker 1 (Sales Cloud Sync)
steps.text: This worker reads the main queue and is solely responsible for communicating with Salesforce via REST API for Contact management.

steps.title: Salesforce Sales Cloud
steps.text: A POST or PATCH operation is executed. If it's a new user, Sales Cloud generates and synchronously returns the native Salesforce ID to the worker.

steps.title: Azure Service Bus (Loop-back)
steps.text: We fire an event to a second queue with the new Salesforce ID. This keeps the process asynchronous and highly fault-tolerant.

steps.title: Worker 2 (Loop-back Handler)
steps.text: The second worker picks up the message containing the Salesforce ID and prepares to save it to our master database.

steps.title: Cosmos DB (Golden Record)
steps.text: The Cosmos DB record is updated with the Salesforce ID. Cosmos DB acts as the single source of truth with a flexible schema (JSON) for pets.

steps.title: Identity Consolidation
steps.text: With the ID saved in Cosmos DB, referential integrity is guaranteed. The system now knows exactly who the user is across both clouds.

steps.title: Azure Service Bus (Activation)
steps.text: A third queue comes into play, this time dedicated exclusively to orchestrating the dispatch of the consolidated record to the Marketing engine.

steps.title: Worker 3 (SFMC Injection)
steps.text: The third worker securely injects the data into Marketing Cloud using the API Event, triggering the customer journey.

steps.title: Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder)
steps.text: The user enters a shared Data Extension. A Decision Split evaluates if the profile is new or updated to send the appropriate email.

steps.title: Monitoring & Continuous Development
steps.text: End-to-end observability. We use Azure Monitor and Application Insights alongside Salesforce metrics to track the health of the entire data pipeline.

steps.title: Environments & CI/CD
steps.text: Isolated environments (DEV, STAGING, PROD) are defined to validate code and test the end-to-end flow simulating production load before impacting the end user.
